newsitem.title: USA: CDSI files amendment to Control Data offer.
newsitem.headline: CDSI files amendment to Control Data offer.

text.p: CDSI Holding Corp said on Wednesday that it had filed an amendement to its tender offer for common stock in Control Data Systems Inc regarding negotiations it is conducting with two commercial banks to provide a $128 million credit facility.
The filing, also made by CDSI's subsidiary, CDSI Acquisition Corp, concerns a tender offer for Control Data shares at $20.25 per share, net to seller without interest.
Also discussed in the amendment, CDSI said, is a bridge loan facility of up to $85 million.
In addition, the amendment reports that CDSI was granted early termination of the waiting period necessary to acquire anit-trust clearance, CDSI said in a statement.
